entities.summary: Guyana is a sovereign nation in South America, Americas. Its capital is Georgetown. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 0.8 million. Area: 214,969 km². Comprehensive index for Guyana covering indigenous Arawak/Carib/Warao peoples, Dutch colonization (Essequibo, Demerara, Berbice), Berbice slave rebellion 1763 (Cuffy national hero), British takeover 1814, sugar/slavery/indentured Indian labor, Cheddi Jagan/Forbes Burnham rivalry, CIA interference, independence 1966, cooperative republic, Jonestown massacre 1978 (913 dead), ethnic Indo-Guyanese vs Afro-Guyanese tensions, and oil discovery 2015 (transformative).
